shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find pages components styles -type f -maxdepth 5 -print -exec sh -c 'printf \"\\n\"; sed -n \"1,240p\" \""'$1"'"' _ {} \\;"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files app components lib | sort && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css && rg -n "next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse|pages/" app components lib styles || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && test ! -d pages && printf '"'pages directory removed\\n' && rg --files app components lib | sort"
